project.name: oxiguitar-audio-pipewire-plugin
project.description: The PipeWire audio output plugin for OxiGuitar, a free, open-source guitar tablature and score viewer, editor and player. It plays OxiGuitar's sound through PipeWire, the sound system of current Linux desktops, with the lowest latency of the Linux outputs.

nodes.name: CI Workflow
nodes.summary: Main CI pipeline: runs formatting, linting, tests on 6 platforms, license checks, and DCO sign-off verification. The ci-success job gates all merges.

nodes.name: Release Workflow
nodes.summary: Test builds on pull requests and draft releases on v* tags. Builds .oxp, .deb, .rpm packages via oxiguitar-packages reusable workflow.

nodes.name: Publish Workflow
nodes.summary: Triggers after a release is published. Notifies package repositories and winget via oxiguitar-packages plugin-publish workflow.

nodes.name: Cargo Manifest
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest: defines the oxiguitar-audio-pipewire-plugin crate, its dependencies on oxiguitar-plugin SDK, oxiguitar-audio-cpal shared core, and cpal with PipeWire host. Sets lints for unsafe_code denial and clippy warnings.

nodes.name: Cargo Deny Configuration
nodes.summary: cargo-deny configuration enforcing GPL-3.0-compatible licenses, denying unknown git sources and wildcards. Targets all six build platforms.

nodes.name: Clippy Configuration
nodes.summary: Clippy lint configuration for the Rust project.

nodes.name: Rustfmt Configuration
nodes.summary: Rust code formatting configuration.

nodes.name: Plugin Manifest
nodes.summary: OxiGuitar plugin manifest defining interface version 1.3, plugin ID oxiguitar.audio-pipewire, Linux-only conditions, and the audio-device/pipewire service with priority 20.

nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Project overview: PipeWire audio output plugin for OxiGuitar. Covers installation, build instructions, history, and licensing.

nodes.name: Changelog
nodes.summary: Version history following Keep a Changelog format. First release (0.1.0) split from the main OxiGuitar repository.

nodes.name: Contributing Guide
nodes.summary: Contribution guidelines: branch model (develop/main), squash merges, DCO sign-off requirements, and bot commit handling.

nodes.name: Claude Working Guide
nodes.summary: Standing rules for AI-assisted development: library usage policy, branch model, DCO compliance, and project-specific conventions.

nodes.name: Build Script
nodes.summary: Shell script that builds the .oxp release plugin file using cargo with --features oxp --crate-type cdylib. Runs on Linux only and outputs to dist/.

nodes.name: Main Plugin Implementation
nodes.summary: Core plugin implementation: defines the Audio struct implementing Plugin and Service traits. Wraps oxiguitar_audio_cpal::CpalDevice with cpal's PipeWire host. Provides probe() and call() methods for the audio-device/pipewire service interface.

nodes.name: Audio::start
nodes.summary: Plugin initialization: creates a CpalDevice with PipeWire host. Returns a platform-independent stub on non-Linux.

nodes.name: Audio::service
nodes.summary: Service lookup: returns self as the audio-device/pipewire service when the interface and id match.

nodes.name: Audio::probe
nodes.summary: Device probe: checks PipeWire availability via CpalDevice on Linux, returns Unavailable on other platforms.

nodes.name: Audio::call
nodes.summary: Service method dispatcher: forwards method calls to CpalDevice on Linux, returns Unsupported error on other platforms.

nodes.name: Audio struct
nodes.summary: The OxiGuitar audio plugin struct. Contains a CpalDevice (Linux-only) and implements Plugin and Service traits.

nodes.name: Contract Test Suite
nodes.summary: Integration test: builds the .oxp file via oxiguitar_plugin_test::build() and validates it through OxiGuitar's plugin host. Linux-only.

nodes.name: the_plugin_file_keeps_the_contract
nodes.summary: Single contract test: builds the .oxp and runs the full plugin host validation suite.

nodes.name: Dependabot Configuration
nodes.summary: Weekly automated dependency updates for cargo and github-actions ecosystems. Excludes OxiGuitar SDK dependencies pinned by git tag.

nodes.name: Pull Request Template
nodes.summary: PR template: requires description, test instructions, and checklist for tests/docs/DCO compliance.

nodes.name: DCO Sign-off Checker
nodes.summary: Shell script verifying DCO sign-off on every commit in a PR range. Skips Claude app and Dependabot commits. Used by the CI dco job.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand what oxiguitar-pipewire is: a PipeWire audio output plugin for OxiGuitar, a guitar tablature and score viewer. It plays OxiGuitar's sound through PipeWire with the lowest latency on Linux desktops.

tour.title: Plugin Manifest
tour.description: The manifest.json defines the plugin's identity: interface version 1.3, plugin ID oxiguitar.audio-pipewire, Linux-only conditions, and the audio-device/pipewire service with priority 20.

tour.title: Build Configuration
tour.description: Cargo.toml defines the crate, its dependencies on the OxiGuitar plugin SDK, the shared cpal audio core, and cpal with PipeWire host. The build-oxp.sh script compiles the .oxp release file.

tour.title: Core Plugin Implementation
tour.description: src/lib.rs is the heart of the plugin. The Audio struct implements Plugin (start) and Service (service, probe, call) traits. It wraps a CpalDevice using cpal's PipeWire host, with platform guards ensuring it compiles everywhere but only functions on Linux.

tour.title: Contract Testing
tour.description: tests/contract.rs builds the .oxp file and validates it through OxiGuitar's plugin host — the same way the app would load it. This ensures the plugin meets the SDK contract.

tour.title: Code Quality and Security
tour.description: Three config files enforce code quality: rustfmt.toml for formatting, clippy.toml for linting, and deny.toml for license compliance and dependency security. All dependencies are checked against GPL-3.0 compatibility.

tour.title: CI/CD Pipelines
tour.description: Three GitHub Actions workflows: ci.yml runs tests on 6 platforms, checks formatting, linting, licenses, and DCO sign-off; release.yml builds packages on PRs and draft releases; publish.yml notifies package repos after a release.

tour.title: Compliance and Contributing
tour.description: The DCO sign-off checker (scripts/check-dco.sh) verifies commit sign-offs in CI. CONTRIBUTING.md explains the branch model and sign-off process. CLAUDE.md documents standing rules for AI-assisted development.
